ⓐ.summary: Watching the movie (the experimental stimulus) reduced the degree of negative prejudice against Black people.

c1.text: Watching the movie (the experimental stimulus) reduced the degree of negative prejudice against Black people.

c2.text: Watching the movie (the experimental stimulus) did not reduce the degree of negative prejudice against Black people.

c3.text: In the experimental design, Group 1 receives pre-test, experimental stimulus, and post-test; Group 2 receives pre-test and post-test without experimental stimulus.

c4.text: In the experimental design, Group 3 receives no pre-test, experimental stimulus, and post-test; Group 4 receives no pre-test and post-test without experimental stimulus.

c5.text: All participants in Groups 1 to 4 were randomly selected from the population.

c6.text: Because participants were randomly selected, baseline prejudice is equivalent across groups, enabling comparisons between groups.

h1.text: In Group 1, the degree of prejudice in the post-test was lower than the degree of prejudice in the pre-test.

1.note: Pre-test to post-test reduction in Group 1 (which received the stimulus) demonstrates ⓐ.

h2.text: The degree of prejudice in the post-test of Group 1 was lower than the degree of prejudice in the post-test of Group 2.

2.note: Post-test of Group 1 (stimulus) lower than post-test of Group 2 (control) demonstrates ⓐ.

h3.text: The degree of prejudice in the post-test of Group 3 was lower than the degree of prejudice in the pre-test of Group 2.

3.note: Post-test of Group 3 (stimulus, no pre-test) lower than baseline (pre-test of Group 2) demonstrates ⓐ.

h4.text: The degree of prejudice in the post-test of Group 3 was lower than the degree of prejudice in the post-test of Group 4.

4.note: Post-test of Group 3 (stimulus) lower than post-test of Group 4 (control) without pre-test demonstrates ⓐ.

h5.text: The degree of prejudice in the post-test of Group 4 was lower than the degree of prejudice in the post-test of Group 1.

5.note: Group 4 (control) having lower post-test prejudice than Group 1 (stimulus) does not support ⓐ; it supports c2 (the stimulus did not reduce prejudice), so strengthens evaluates to false.
